title: PowerShell panel: interaction and real shell checks passed
summary: Validated compact terminal controls, prompt input scheduling, session recovery and real PowerShell state.

changes.detail: Consistent dark toolbar, responsive touch controls, session path, readable terminal typography, Arabic direction support and a compact footer.
Input wakes idle polling after an 8 ms batching window; requests remain serialized, hidden sessions poll less often, and returning to a session refits and wakes it.
Removed all-runtime discovery from startup and the oversized shared button layout.
Explicit connecting, disconnected and ended states, localized connection errors and empty-session guidance. Failed commands are never automatically replayed.

validation.name: TypeScript and focused lint
validation.detail: Learning app npm.cmd run typecheck and ESLint for TeacherLab.web.tsx, WebTerminalSession.tsx and terminal-pump.ts completed without diagnostics.

validation.name: Terminal request and UI tests
validation.detail: 5 tests passed: serialized immediate input, batching/chunking, no replay after failure, hidden-session wake/stop, direct runtime startup, RTL markup, controls, explain selection, reconnect errors, restart cleanup and returning-session resize.

validation.name: History regression tests
validation.detail: 6 archive and interaction tests passed, including append preservation, retry and older-bundle retention.

validation.name: Real PowerShell
validation.detail: Existing real PowerShell test passed: variables, directory changes and owner isolation. node-pty emitted an AttachConsole cleanup diagnostic after the passing test; runner exited 0.

validation.name: Visual and deployment validation
validation.detail: Browser tool inventory exposed no browser or app. No visual screenshot review, physical mobile check, production build/deployment or end-to-end latency measurement. Scheduling improvements are code/test verified, not a measured network speed guarantee.
